name: Flagsmith
summary: Flagsmith offers hosted feature flags with a free plan for one team member and 50,000 requests a month. Start-Up costs $40 a month on yearly billing or $45 monthly, and Scale-Up costs $250 or $300. Enterprise is quoted and can run from cloud to air-gapped.

facts.text: The Free plan allows 1 team member, 1 project, 50,000 requests a month and unlimited flags, environments and segments.
Extra API calls start at $50 per million per month and the rate falls with volume, while the FAQ lists Start-Up overage at $7 per 100K requests.
SAML single sign-on is listed on Scale-Up, and LDAP with SCIM is marked as coming soon on Enterprise.
Client-side SDKs cover JavaScript, Android and Kotlin, iOS and Swift, React, Next.js and Flutter, and a separate page lists server-side SDKs.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: The page shows $ without naming a currency

plans.name: Start-Up
plans.notes: $40 a month on yearly billing paid up front, or $45 billed monthly. 14-day trial. 1,000,000 requests and 3 team members

plans.name: Scale-Up
plans.notes: $250 a month on yearly billing, or $300 billed monthly. 14-day trial. 5,000,000+ requests, 5 team members included and up to 20 at $50 each per month

hiddenCosts: Requests above the plan allowance are charged as overage, starting at $50 per million per month.
